{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVQjdzc8AAAABZmAipw", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bn3IVzhDMi1A", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bn3IV", "number": 57, "title": "Correct VDP1 scaled sprite texture sampling against Sega’s reference vectors", "body": "## Problem

Related to #17

At `cd887d6d86b8386ed7b0656773d920e4cd1de2cd`, `Vdp1::texture_coordinates` interpolates between source endpoints using the destination span. Existing native and browser expectations encode that calculation, although it disagrees with Sega’s illustrated texture sampling.

For an eight-pixel source reduced to four pixels with HSS disabled, the implementation selects `[0,2,4,7]`; Sega’s Figure 6.5 selects `[1,3,5,7]`. An eight-to-three reduction similarly produces `[0,3,7]` instead of `[1,4,6]`. Enlargement and HSS-enabled reductions also have distinguishing examples. This can shift or discard texture features across scaled and distorted sprites.

## Expected outcome

Implement specification-derived horizontal source sampling for scaled and distorted sprite raster lines, including HSS/EOS selection, through the existing clocked texture-fetch and framebuffer paths. Preserve destination geometry, clipping, retained memory transactions and command progression.

Use the [VDP1 manual §6.3, Figure 6.5](https://www.infochunk.com/saturn/segahtml_en/hard/vdp1/hon/p06_31.htm), §4.2 FBCR/EOS, and [§7.5](https://www.infochunk.com/saturn/segahtml_en/hard/vdp1/hon/p07_50.htm)/[§7.6](https://www.infochunk.com/saturn/segahtml_en/hard/vdp1/hon/p07_60.htm). Reconcile ST-013-R3 with the later manual and applicable corrections before choosing the stepping algorithm. Keep the later manual’s explicit HSS end-code rule: HSS ignores end codes at every magnification, also affirmed in [Chapter 9](https://www.infochunk.com/saturn/segahtml_en/hard/vdp1/hon/p09_10.htm). Do not infer a different rule from the conflicting ECD summary table.

## Context and reproduction

Local HEAD and upstream main both match the revision above. The supplied snapshot lists no open task Issues. Main CI is in progress; that observation establishes neither failure nor success.

Relevant implementation and evidence:

- `src/vdp1.rs:819`: raster-line source endpoints.
- `src/vdp1.rs:843`: endpoint interpolation followed by HSS parity adjustment.
- `tests/video.rs:619`: existing sampling vectors.
- `tests/fixtures/build_sprite_shrink.py:20`, `tests/sprite_shrink.rs` and `scripts/browser-smoke.mjs:900`: guest and browser expectations containing the same discrepancy.

A read-only arithmetic check reproduced the endpoint calculation; no native/Wasm suite was rerun during planning. Reproduce the device mismatch with eight distinct source colors, ECD disabled, and a four-pixel destination span. Compare framebuffer colors with the independently transcribed manual vector.

Scope is horizontal texture selection and its integration with existing drawing. General polygon coverage, vertical scaling accuracy and physical draw bandwidth remain separate work.

## Pre-merge acceptance criteria

- [ ] Document the corrected contract with exact primary sections, figure rows and applicable corrections. Record any evidence-backed correction to this AI-generated task in the source Issue with references and rationale; no human confirmation is required.
- [ ] Add independent literal vectors covering every illustrated eight-pixel-source ratio from 3/8 through 10/8. Include HSS disabled and both EOS selections where applicable. Distinguishing examples must include HSS=0 eight-to-four `[1,3,5,7]`, eight-to-three `[1,4,6]`, and HSS=1/EOS=0 eight-to-three `[0,4,6]`. Expectations must not call production sampling helpers or derive from emulator captures.
- [ ] Implement the corrected stepping through actual texture acquisition and drawing. Validate additional legal source widths, unchanged size, enlargement, both horizontal directions, command flips, scaled commands and distorted rows with differing spans. Explain generalization beyond the illustrated ratios and any remaining uncertainty.
- [ ] Exercise all six texture formats with independently authored words/pixels, including packed-word crossings and lookup data. Preserve transparency, documented end-code behavior, mesh, Gouraud processing and clipping intent. Correct obsolete numeric expectations only with documented specification derivations; retain their substantive coverage.
- [ ] Verify partial progress and retained texture words under VRAM contention and writes around acquisition boundaries. Check advancement chunks 1/3/17/10000, passive debugger inspection, ENDR/PTMR cancellation and reset without stale sampling state or duplicated publication. Distinguish inherited timing conventions from specification-established behavior.
- [ ] Extend the original MIT-licensed guest fixture, or add a focused original fixture, to build distinct textures and scaled/distorted commands through SH-2 instructions/MMIO, await completion, read framebuffer results and compute diagnostic records. Include changed-texture and omitted-draw controls, repeated cold boots, reproducible source/media hashes and no host-written results.
- [ ] Run identical guest bytes in native Machine integration and rebuilt production Wasm under `/saturn-rust/`. Assert distinguishing framebuffer values and actual Canvas pixels. Demonstrate that the inherited sampling path fails at least one new independent native and browser assertion.
- [ ] Preserve Star Collector, Prism Courier, Hardware Lab and existing hardware regressions. Pass `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo build --locked`, `cargo test --locked`, native and Wasm Clippy with warnings denied, registered fixture/media reproducibility checks, `sh scripts/build-web.sh`, and the complete extended `npm run test:browser` without required skips.
- [ ] Update the conformance matrix and validation record with implementation/test/spec links, actual results and remaining deviations. All unmet #17 CPU/peripheral, bus/reset/multiprocessor timing, SCU/DSP, video/audio, CD/media/HLE, SMPC and integrated acceptance requirements remain mandatory. This partial improvement must not claim hardware completion or demonstrated commercial compatibility. Preserve #17’s umbrella scope and do not reopen historical trackers.

## Optional validation

None required. No personal firmware, commercial media, physical console, human approval or live Pages inspection is needed.

## Required post-merge verification

None.
